non_default: license: 30-day trial (searchable snapshots on the frozen tier need Elastic Enterprise)
xpack.security.enabled=false: one throwaway node, port bound to 127.0.0.1
node.roles: every data role on one node (a dedicated frozen node would hold only data_frozen)
xpack.searchable.snapshot.shared_cache.size=939524096 B: the mounted bytes / 20 rounded down to 16 MiB regions (the Elastic frozen-tier sizing, deliberately smaller than the data)
indices.recovery.max_bytes_per_sec=90mb: the default of a dedicated frozen node with 16 GiB of memory (this mixed-role node would default to 40mb)
index.queries.cache.enabled=false: the node query cache is off for the cold numbers
snapshot repository registered readonly:true for the measuring stage (only the build path writes snapshots)
force-merge to 1 segment per shard before the snapshot: the default of the ILM searchable_snapshot action
index.requests.cache.enable: the Rally track disables it per index; reset to the ES default (enabled) before the snapshot
snapshot repository max_snapshot_bytes_per_sec=1gb (default 40mb): speeds up writing only, not reading
heap not set: auto-sized by ES from the 16g container
